title: Private House Design 212 m², Kharkiv | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 212 m² private house in Kharkiv: interior design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.
h1: Private house interior design in Kharkiv, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 212 m²

blocks.text: Private house interior design in Kharkiv, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 212 m²

parts.html: A 212 m² private house in Kharkiv, Ukraine. We did the interior design with 3D visualization and technical documentation, made the custom furniture and carried out a turnkey renovation. The project covered the living room, a kitchen-dining room with built-in appliances, bedrooms, a children’s room, an entrance hall with a foyer, bathrooms and storage systems. Before work began, we prepared a detailed cost estimate: construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures and lighting. The renovation followed the technical documentation. The gallery shows the project visualizations.

The foyer is separated from the living room by an open shelving unit in a metal frame, flanked by floor-to-ceiling wardrobes with smooth light fronts. By the entrance are a floating console, an oval mirror in a brass frame and a bench. The foyer floor is large light onyx-look tile, and the living room has herringbone parquet. The stair treads are clad in the same tile, and the railing is glass with a bronze handrail.

The living room TV wall is made from an onyx-look slab with golden veining, with narrow slatted inserts and brass profiles along the edges and a long floating unit under the TV. A chandelier of branches with crystal drops hangs above the sofas.

The kitchen is U-shaped, with matte beige handleless fronts and an onyx-look tile backsplash. The ovens are built into a tall unit between two display cabinets with reeded glass. The dining table stands by the window, with a pendant in the form of a glowing ribbon above it.

The bedrooms are under the sloping roof, with skylights. In the main bedroom, the wall behind the bed is lined with soft vertical panels, and opposite are a white TV console and a dressing table. In the second bedroom, a floor-to-ceiling wood-look wardrobe runs along the wall, with a desk, a shelf and lighting built into its niche. In the children’s room, one wall is a pegboard panel with movable shelves.

The bathroom has onyx-look tile on the walls and floor. There is a shower behind glass with a brass frame, a wall-hung toilet and bidet, and a vanity with a stone countertop and two basins set between tall wood-look cabinets. The kitchen, wardrobes, foyer shelving and vanities were designed to fit the room dimensions and the architecture of the house.
